nodes.long_description:
# Für alle Brettspielfans: All On Board! bringt die Magie gemeinsamer Spieleabende in VR/MR zurück.

Lachen, Rivalität, die Stille vor einem entscheidenden Wurf: all das erlebst du hier. Triff dich mit Freunden an einem virtuellen Tisch, der sich echt anfühlt, egal wie weit ihr voneinander entfernt seid.

{1048192680799594}

All On Board! lässt dich digitale Versionen deiner Lieblingsspiele erleben. Die Bibliothek enthält kostenlose Klassiker und lizenzierte Titel, die separat als DLC verkauft werden (nur der Host muss den DLC besitzen; **andere können mit der Basis-App beitreten**).

# Virus! ist jetzt KOSTENLOS verfügbar!
Virus! kommt als kostenloses Spiel in die Bibliothek von All On Board! Sammle deine Organe, schütze sie vor Infektionen und nutze deine Karten, um deinen Gegnern nebenbei das Leben schwer zu machen.

{1078757631280869}{4174878446146040}{1370266377971408}

- **Realistische VR/MR-Erfahrung** mit intuitiver Steuerung  
- **Nur der Host kauft den DLC**; andere spielen mit der Basis-App  
- **Wachsende Bibliothek** mit Klassikern und lizenzierten Spielen  
- **Plattformübergreifendes Spielen** und Mehrsprachenunterstützung  
- **Solo-, Koop-** oder Wettkampfmodus  
- **Learning Hub** (Lernbereich) in jedem Spiel  
- **Speicher- und Fortsetzungsfunktion** jederzeit  

{1825960721322777}

Finde andere Spieler auf Discord oder Telegram und starte eine Runde (keine KI-Gegner).

All On Board! wird von einem unabhängigen Studio entwickelt, das Brettspiele so liebt wie du: mit Leidenschaft, Updates und einer wachsenden Auswahl großartiger Titel.

{1458220045415720}
nodes.short_description: Entwickelt für Brettspielfans: All On Board! bringt die Magie der Spieleabende in VR/MR zurück. Genieße mit deinen Freunden angepasste Versionen deiner Lieblingstitel, mit realistischer Physik und durchdachtem Design: fast wie am echten Spieltisch, egal wo du bist.

nodes.long_description:
# Creato per chi ama i giochi da tavolo, All On Board! riporta in vita la magia delle serate di gioco.

Risate, rivalità e la tensione prima di un lancio decisivo: tutto questo ti aspetta in VR/MR. Riunisciti attorno a un tavolo virtuale che sembra reale, ovunque tu sia.

{1269730997882447}

All On Board! ti permette di giocare alle versioni digitali dei tuoi giochi preferiti. Il catalogo include classici gratuiti e titoli con licenza venduti come DLC (solo l’host deve possedere il DLC; **gli altri possono unirsi con l’app base**).

# Virus! è ora disponibile GRATIS!
Virus! entra a far parte del catalogo come gioco gratuito per tutti i giocatori di All On Board! Raccogli i tuoi organi, proteggili dall'infezione e usa le tue carte per fare dispetti ai tuoi avversari strada facendo.

{1044560438263833}{2034633261261698}{1346272190563471}

- **Esperienza VR/MR realistica** con controlli intuitivi  
- **Solo l’host acquista il titolo con licenza**; gli altri si uniscono con l’app base  
- **Libreria in espansione** con classici gratuiti e titoli con licenza  
- **Gioco multipiattaforma** e supporto multilingue  
- **Modalità solitaria, cooperativa** o competitiva  
- **Learning Hub** (sezione didattica) in ogni gioco  
- **Salva e riprendi** quando vuoi  

{627190099949374}

Trova altri giocatori su Discord o Telegram e inizia una partita (nessun avversario IA).

All On Board! è sviluppato da uno studio indipendente che ama i giochi da tavolo quanto te, con passione, aggiornamenti costanti e un catalogo in crescita.

{786055897409926}
nodes.short_description: Creato per gli amanti dei giochi da tavolo, All On Board! riporta in vita la magia delle serate di gioco in VR/MR. Goditi con i tuoi amici le versioni adattate dei tuoi titoli preferiti, con una fisica realistica e un design curato che rendono ogni partita autentica, ovunque tu sia.

nodes.long_description:
# Conçu pour les passionnés de jeux de société, All On Board! fait revivre la magie des soirées de jeux.

Les rires, la rivalité, la tension avant un lancer décisif… tout est là en VR/MR. Réunissez-vous autour d'une table virtuelle qui paraît réelle, où que vous soyez.

{1457869152034657}

All On Board! vous permet de jouer aux versions numériques de vos jeux préférés. Sa bibliothèque réunit des classiques gratuits et des titres sous licence vendus en DLC (seul l'hôte doit posséder le DLC ; **les autres le rejoignent avec l'application de base**).

# Virus! est maintenant disponible GRATUITEMENT !
Virus! rejoint le catalogue comme **jeu gratuit pour tous les joueurs d'All On Board!** Rassemblez vos organes, protégez-les de l'infection et servez-vous de vos cartes pour embêter vos adversaires au passage.

{3480118418814948}{1779000590179972}{1635597271519222}

- **Expérience VR/MR réaliste** avec commandes intuitives  
- **Seul l’hôte achète le titre sous licence** ; les autres le rejoignent avec l’application de base  
- **Catalogue en expansion** de classiques gratuits et de titres sous licence  
- **Jeu multiplateforme** et prise en charge multilingue
- **Modes solo, coopératif** ou compétitif  
- **Learning Hub** (espace d’apprentissage) dans chaque jeu  
- **Sauvegarde et reprise** à tout moment  

{727775900141776}

Rejoignez d’autres joueurs sur Discord ou Telegram et lancez une partie (aucun adversaire IA).

All On Board! est développé par un studio indépendant animé par la passion du jeu de société, avec des mises à jour régulières et un catalogue en évolution.

{1074388514816063}
nodes.short_description: Conçu pour les passionnés de jeux de société, All On Board! fait revivre la magie des soirées de jeux en VR/MR. Profitez entre amis de versions adaptées de vos titres préférés, avec une physique réaliste et un design soigné qui rendent chaque partie plus vraie que nature, où que vous soyez.

nodes.long_description:
# Built for people who love board games, All On Board! brings game nights back to life.

The laughter, the rivalry, the quiet focus before a decisive roll: it’s all here in VR/MR. Gather around a virtual table that feels real, no matter how far apart you are.
 
{756860736720817}

All On Board! is a platform that lets you enjoy digital versions of the tabletop games you love. The library includes free classics and renowned licensed titles sold separately as DLC (DLC purchase is required only to host; **you can join any game with just the base app**).

# Virus! now available for FREE!
Virus! has arrived, and it joins the platform as a **free game for every All On Board! player**. Collect your organs, keep them safe from infection, and use your cards to mess with your opponents along the way.

{1591471045929021}{2106770173251331}{1375852330589729}

- **Lifelike VR/MR tabletop experience** with realistic physics and intuitive controls
- **Only the host buys the licensed title**; others join with the base app
- **Growing library** of licensed favorites and free classics
- **Cross-platform** and multi-language support
- **Solo**, **co-op**, or competitive sessions
- **Learning Hub in every game** to help you learn fast
- **Save and resume** anytime

{1513545693148653}

Find other players in our Discord or Telegram and start a session (no AI opponents).

All On Board! is made by an independent studio that loves board games as much as you do. It’s built on passion, constant updates, and a growing lineup of great titles.
{1721994118426414}
nodes.short_description: Built for board game lovers, All On Board! brings back the magic of game nights to VR/MR. Enjoy adapted versions of your favorite titles with friends, lifelike physics, and thoughtful design that make every match feel real, like gathering around a table wherever you are.

nodes.long_description:
# Creado para quienes aman los juegos de mesa, All On Board! recupera la magia de las noches de juegos.

Las risas, la rivalidad y la tensión antes de una tirada decisiva, ¡todo está en VR/MR! Reúnete con tus amigos alrededor de una mesa que se siente real, sin importar la distancia.

{1093798885534135}

All On Board! te permite disfrutar versiones digitales de tus juegos favoritos. Su biblioteca incluye clásicos gratuitos y títulos con licencia vendidos como DLC (solo el anfitrión necesita el DLC; **los demás pueden unirse con la app base**).

# Virus! ya disponible GRATIS
Virus! ha llegado y se suma al catálogo de la plataforma como un **juego gratis para todos los jugadores de All On Board!** Los brotes de virus se han escapado del laboratorio. Reúne tus órganos, protégelos de la infección y usa tus cartas para fastidiar a tus oponentes por el camino.

{1835519583960609}{1070225539137793}{988803837523439}

- **Experiencia VR/XR realista** con controles intuitivos  
- **Solo el anfitrión compra el DLC**; los demás se unen con la app base  
- **Biblioteca en expansión** con clásicos gratuitos y con licencia  
- **Juego multiplataforma** y soporte multilingüe  
- **Sesiones en solitario, cooperativas** o competitivas  
- **Learning Hub** (centro de aprendizaje) en cada juego  
- **Guarda y reanuda** partidas en cualquier momento  

{1091117019056443}

Encuentra otros jugadores en Discord o Telegram y empieza una partida (sin oponentes IA).

All On Board! está desarrollado por un estudio independiente que ama los juegos tanto como tú, impulsado por la pasión, las actualizaciones y un catálogo en crecimiento.

{1432887354426652}
nodes.short_description: Pensado para los amantes de los juegos de mesa, All On Board! recupera la magia de las noches de juegos en VR/MR. Disfruta de versiones adaptadas de tus títulos favoritos junto a tus amigos, con físicas realistas y un diseño cuidado que hace que cada partida se sienta real, estés donde estés.

nodes.long_description:
All On Board! is a revolutionary tabletop platform built from the ground up specifically for VR, created by and for board game enthusiasts. As the only platform natively built for VR, All On Board! fully exploits the capabilities of virtual reality to deliver an unmatched board gaming experience. This includes predictive selection and positioning of board elements while enjoying realistic physical interactions close to real life. A unique platform that is constantly evolving, both functionally and in its game catalog, packed with beloved franchises among board game enthusiasts.

Experience the joy of discovering new games, just like browsing the latest releases at your favorite store: All On Board! brings you shared moments of discussion, laughter, and nostalgia reminiscent of past adventures and unforgettable games.

Features:

- Only one player is required to purchase game titles: If you own a game, you can invite your friends to play for free, just like in real life
- Experience interactions that are intuitive and naturally immersive
- Top-tier games meticulously adapted for VR, ensuring exceptional gameplay and smooth interactions
- Quickly learn the rules with in-game tutorials and contextual help that provides more information about any component
- Tailored gameplay for 1 to multiple players, including solo and co-op modes. You can even tackle cooperative games on your own!
- Cross-platform support
- Play in your preferred language, with ongoing additions to our language support
nodes.short_description: Designed from the ground up for VR, All On Board! offers seamless board game experiences. Join this ever-evolving platform and connect with fellow board game enthusiasts! Choose your avatar and enjoy playing solo or with friends, diving into some of the most popular board game franchises.
